reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Add support for custom storage namespace in HelmRelease creation by @prasad89 in https://github.com/fluxcd/flux2/pull/5534", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: The release note only announces a new capability for HelmRelease creation; it describes no failure, rejection, ignored setting, permission change, or altered behaviour for existing configurations, so an operator who does nothing simply gains the new option.
consequence.remediation: Operators wanting a custom storage namespace for new HelmReleases can use the new capability; nothing must be done otherwise.

proposed.statement: Flux 2.7.0 adds support for specifying a custom storage namespace when creating a HelmRelease; the release note does not name the flag or field that implements this capability.
